eval: (() => { const g = game, p = g.player, V = p.position.constructor, cam = g.engine.camera; g.markers.clear(); p.position.set(-29, g.terrain.heightAt(-29, -28), -28); p.velocity.set(0, 0, 0); p.yaw = 1.0; p.pitch = -0.02; g.chunks.warmup(p.position); p.update(1 / 30); cam.updateMatrixWorld(); for (const M of [g.boars, g.deer]) { for (let i = M.active.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) M.release(i); M.frozen = true; M.spawnTimer = 1e9; } window.__look = (pt) => { const e = cam.position; const dx = pt.x - e.x, dy = pt.y - e.y, dz = pt.z - e.z; p.yaw = Math.atan2(-dx, -dz); p.pitch = Math.atan2(dy, Math.hypot(dx, dz)); p.update(1 / 30); cam.updateMatrixWorld(); }; window.__clearSpot = (dist) => { for (let a = 0; a < 6.28; a += 0.06) { const x = p.position.x + Math.cos(a) * dist, z = p.position.z + Math.sin(a) * dist; const y = g.terrain.heightAt(x, z) + 1.0; const dir = new V(x - cam.position.x, y - cam.position.y, z - cam.position.z); const dd = dir.length(); dir.divideScalar(dd); if (g.terrain.raycast(cam.position, dir, dd) < dd) continue; if (g.chunks.raycastObstacles(cam.position, dir, dd).kind) continue; if (!g.chunks.isClear(x, z, 2)) continue; return { x, z }; } return null; }; const s = __clearSpot(45); const d = g.deer.spawn(new V(s.x, 0, s.z), Math.atan2(p.position.x - s.x, p.position.z - s.z) + Math.PI / 2, 1.1, 0); d.pose('forage', 0); window.__deer = d; __look(d.group.position); g.input.pressed.add('KeyQ'); return { distanciaDoVeado: +cam.position.distanceTo(d.group.position).toFixed(1) }; })()
label: mira no veado e aperta Q

eval: (() => { const g = game, m = g.markers.list; const d = __deer.group.position; return { marcadores: m.length, numero: m[0] && m[0].n, distanciaDoMarcadorAoVeado: m[0] && +m[0].pos.distanceTo(d).toFixed(2), aviso: document.querySelector('.hud-kill').textContent }; })()
label: marcador no veado

eval: (() => { const pin = document.querySelector('.hud-pin'); const r = pin.getBoundingClientRect(); const fita = [...document.querySelectorAll('.hud-compass .pin')].map(e => ({ texto: e.textContent, x: +(new DOMMatrix(getComputedStyle(e).transform).m41).toFixed(0), op: +(+getComputedStyle(e).opacity).toFixed(2) })).filter(e => e.op > 0.01); return { losangoVisivel: !pin.hidden, pontaEmPx: [Math.round(r.left + r.width / 2), Math.round(r.bottom)], centroDaTela: [innerWidth / 2, innerHeight / 2], texto: pin.textContent, naFita: fita }; })()
label: olhando para ele: losango no centro, pino no meio da fita

eval: (() => { const p = game.player; p.yaw += 0.5; p.update(1 / 30); return 'virou ~29°'; })()

eval: (() => { const g = game, p = g.player, d = __deer.group.position; const antes = Math.hypot(d.x - p.position.x, d.z - p.position.z); const dir = { x: (d.x - p.position.x) / antes, z: (d.z - p.position.z) / antes }; p.position.x += dir.x * 20; p.position.z += dir.z * 20; p.position.y = g.terrain.heightAt(p.position.x, p.position.z); __look(d); return { antes: +antes.toFixed(1) }; })()
label: anda 20 m em direção ao marcador

eval: (() => { const g = game; __look(__deer.group.position); g.input.pressed.add('KeyQ'); return 'Q olhando para o marcador'; })()

(() => { const g = game, M = g.markers, V = g.player.position.constructor, eye = new V(0, 5, 0); M.clear(); const out = []; for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) { const a = i * 0.6; const dir = new V(Math.sin(a), 0, -Math.cos(a)); const r = M.toggle(eye, dir, eye.clone().addScaledVector(dir, 50)); out.push(r.action + ' ' + r.n); } return { acoes: out, restam: M.list.map(m => m.n) }; })()
